title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports (Relatório de Ouvidoria) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven background in Client Advocacy, Ombudsman (Ouvidoria), Legal, or Regulatory Compliance within BCB-regulated financial institutions, payments, or crypto platforms.
  • Consumer Law: Solid working knowledge of the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (Código de Defesa do Consumidor - CDC) and BCB Ouvidoria regulations.
  • Certifications: Active Ombudsman Certification (Certificação de Ouvidoria by Anbima, Febraban, or Abecip), required.
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory) and professional working English (preferred).

Desired Competencies

  • Regulatory Compliance & Dispute Resolution: Deep understanding of BCB consumer protection frameworks, Resolution BCB 28/2021, CMN 4,860/2020, and the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code (CDC).
  • Executive Presence: Ability to act as an autonomous authority, presenting independent semi-annual Ombudsman reports (Relatórios de Ouvidoria) to the Board of Directors and BCB examiners.
  • Strong Analytical & Root-Cause Analysis Skills: Capability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring product/operational bottlenecks, and drive structural recommendations.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Strong commitment to meeting strict regulatory response deadlines (BCB SLA requirements) and managing regulatory exposure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mediation: Proven ability to liaise neutrally between aggrieved customers, internal business lines, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams.
  • Ability to build scalable dispute resolution infrastructure: Capacity to design and scale second-instance ticketing systems, automated SLA tracking, and complaint reporting workflows tailored for fast-growing financial platforms.

Nice to Have

  • Fintech & Cross-Border Experience: Background handling complex customer grievances related to international wire transfers, eFX exchange rates, Pix transactions, or digital asset settlements.
  • BACEN Reporting Exposure: Prior experience inputting data into or submitting regulatory complaint reports through official BCB reporting portals (Unifoco/RDR).
  • Legal/Regulatory Background: Formal education or background in Legal, Consumer Law, or Compliance within regulated financial institutions (IPs/SDFs/VASPs) in Brasil.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Auditor - Barra da Tijuca/RJ
description:
A White Martins é a maior empresa de gases industriais e medicinais da América Latina. Subsidiária da Linde plc, ela é sede do grupo para sete países do continente que abrangem mais de 5 mil colaboradores. Em âmbito global, o grupo reúne cerca de 80 mil funcionários e está presente em mais de 100 países.

Sua Linha de Produtos e serviços é das mais completas do mercado: inclui gases atmosféricos (oxigênio, nitrogênio e argônio), gases de processo (gás carbônico, acetileno, hidrogênio e misturas para soldagem), carbureto de cálcio, além de gases especiais e medicinais.

Em linha com sua missão de construir um mundo mais produtivo, a empresa aprimora o desempenho econômico e ambiental de seus clientes e opera em setores que são pilares da economia nacional: alimentos e bebidas, gás natural, meio ambiente, metal-mecânico, segmentos de pequeno consumo, mineração e siderurgia. Além disso, atua fortemente na área da saúde por meio do fornecimento de gases medicinais e de equipamentos médico-hospitalar.

Siga conosco e confira nossas soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Auditor - Matriz/RJ - Diretoria Auditoria

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Executar projetos de Auditoria Interna sob orientação de auditores seniores e gerentes da área.
  • Realizar testes, análises e avaliações de processos, riscos e controles internos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Participar de auditorias financeiras, operacionais, de compliance e investigações, conforme demanda da área.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios, apresentações e documentação dos trabalhos realizados.
  • Acompanhar planos de ação decorrentes das auditorias realizadas.
  • Interagir com diferentes áreas do negócio para levantamento de informações e entendimento dos processos auditados.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Auditoria Interna e/ou Externa.
  • Conhecimento de governança corporativa, gestão de riscos, controles internos e compliance.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Espanhol intermediário
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau, SQL ou Python será considerado diferencial.

title: Transport Experts
description:
Transport Experts – Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project "Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006."

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer.

The contract is expected to start in January 2027 and will have an implementation period of 48 months. Experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance assignments globally, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific.

We are seeking experienced professionals across a broad range of transport and mobility disciplines to join our Transport Experts Talent Pool.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation, appraisal and implementation of transport and connectivity projects.
  • Conducting prefeasibility and feasibility studies, technical assessments, economic and financial analyses, and sector studies.
  • Supporting transport infrastructure planning, design, rehabilitation, modernisation and investment planning.
  • Assisting public authorities and transport institutions in developing policies, strategies, regulatory frameworks and sector reform programmes.
  • Supporting the preparation of transport investment pipelines aligned with Global Gateway and European Green Deal priorities.
  • Advising on sustainable, low-carbon, smart, safe, resilient and inclusive transport solutions.
  • Supporting multimodal transport, logistics connectivity and integration between different transport modes.
  • Assessing investment climates and identifying opportunities for public and private sector participation, including PPPs.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, contract management, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning.
  • Supporting the application and promotion of European and international transport standards and good practices.
  • Contributing to institutional strengthening, knowledge creation, training and capacity-building activities.
  • Facilitating coordination between public authorities, EU Delegations, IFIs, infrastructure operators, private sector stakeholders and development partners.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in transport, infrastructure, mobility, logistics, connectivity or related sectors, with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Road and highway infrastructure;

Railway infrastructure, operations, interoperability and signalling;

Ports, maritime transport and inland waterways;

Aviation and airport infrastructure;

Urban mobility and public transport;

Logistics corridors and freight transport;

Multimodal transport and regional connectivity;

Transport planning and infrastructure asset management;

Transport economics, demand analysis and modelling;

Sustainable and low-carbon transport;

E-mobility and transport decarbonisation;

Transport safety;

Climate-resilient transport infrastructure and disaster risk reduction;

Infrastructure project preparation, feasibility studies and project appraisal;

Construction supervision and quality assurance;

Transport sector policy, regulation and institutional reform;

Infrastructure finance, PPPs and private sector participation;

Procurement, contract management and FIDIC;

Environmental and social aspects of transport infrastructure.

  • Experience in international technical assistance, donor-funded and/or IFI-financed projects is highly desirable.
  • Professional experience in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and/or Asia and the Pacific will be considered a strong asset.
  • Familiarity with EU transport policies, Global Gateway, the European Green Deal, G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment and international infrastructure standards is advantageous.
  • Experience working with public authorities, transport agencies, infrastructure operators, IFIs, development partners and/or private sector stakeholders is desirable.
  • Strong analytical, coordination, stakeholder engagement and reporting skills.

Language Requirements

  • Excellent command of English is required.
  • Knowledge of French and/or Spanish will be considered a strong asset depending on the assignment.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Key Account Manager (KAM) - Distributor Management
description:
Job Purpose:

Gerenciar a malha de distribuidores da Cipla Brasil, garantindo a saúde do canal (giro de estoque, abastecimento e entrega no prazo), coordenando a participação dos distribuidores nas licitações públicas e absorvendo a gestão do long tail de contratos de menor valor. A posição é o elo entre a companhia, os distribuidores e os KAMs de mercado, assegurando que o produto esteja disponível no ponto de compra e que os contratos públicos sejam executados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1 Gestão de Estoque e Giro (DOI): normalizar o DOI da carteira de distribuidores; prioridade absoluta na monitorar giro por distribuidor e produto; evitar excesso de estoque que bloqueie novas ordens.

2 Coordenação de Licitações: definir qual distribuidor participa de cada licitação, evitando canibalização entre distribuidores da Cipla no mesmo edital; garantir margem competitiva; alinhar cadastro e habilitação nos portais.

3 Abastecimento e Entrega: garantir fill rate (≥98%); padronizar fluxo empenho → entrega → faturamento; garantir OTIF (≥95%).

4 Gestão do Long Tail: absorver contratos públicos de menor valor (abaixo de R$ 50 mil) via distribuidores, liberando os 2 KAMs públicos para os contratos âncora; garantir renovação e abastecimento.

5 Negociação Comercial: negociar condições, margens e prazos com cada distribuidor; revisar contratos de recompra e sell-out; alinhar calendário de ressuprimento.

6 Inteligência de Canal: monitorar saúde financeira e operacional dos distribuidores; acompanhar concorrência; alimentar a liderança com insights.

Perfil Profissional Desejado:

Formação: ensino superior completo em Administração, Farmácia, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação ou MBA em Supply Chain, Gestão Comercial (diferencial).

Experiência: mínimo de 8 a 10 anos em gestão de canais de distribuição, trade marketing ou supply chain na indústria farmacêutica; experiência comprovada em gestão de distribuidores e negociação comercial; vivência com o mercado público de saúde (desejável); experiência em laboratórios indianos (diferencial).

Habilidades: forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamento com distribuidores; visão analítica para gestão de estoque e KPIs de canal (DOI, OTIF, fill rate); orientação a resultados; comunicação clara com múltiplos stakeholders; disponibilidade para viagens; inglês desejável.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview:

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students' plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC's Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students' progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students' learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC's Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Localization QA Specialist - Brazilian Portuguese
description:
Why We Need You:

We're on the hunt for a native Brazilian Portuguese speaker to join our localization crew. You'll be the human voice that makes our AI-powered imaging and design apps feel effortlessly natural in Brazil — because even the smartest AI needs a real person to catch the subtle stuff and bring the right vibe. If you're the kind of person who notices a misplaced comma from across the room and gets a kick out of making tech feel truly local, let's talk.

What You'll Do:

  • UI Copy Refinement: Proofread and refine AI-translated copy across buttons, dialogs, notifications, settings, and other UI elements to nail accuracy, flow, consistency, and a tone that feels natural for the Brazilian market.
  • In-App Linguistic QA: Run in-app linguistic QA — verify translations display correctly, catch truncation, layout quirks, context slips, and anything that might read as culturally off or awkward in Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Cultural Alignment: Review in-app copy to make sure it aligns with local language habits, user expectations, and cultural norms in Brazil, flagging content that feels unnatural or insensitive.
  • Marketing Localization: Translate, review, and localize marketing content like promos, App Store listings, push notifications, in-app campaigns, and social media posts so they resonate with Brazilian users.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Team up with product, design, and engineering to spot localization issues early and push overall quality higher.

Who You Are:

  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a rock-solid command of grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural intuition in your language.
  • Hands-On Experience: 1+ year of hands-on localization, UI translation, or linguistic QA experience for apps, software, or websites.
  • Sharp Detail Orientation: Sharp eye for translation flubs, term inconsistencies, UI truncation, formatting hiccups, and cultural mismatches — you genuinely care about polish and getting every detail right.
  • UI/UX Awareness: Comfortable with UI/UX fundamentals like character limits, responsive layouts, and how translated text behaves inside different interface components.
  • Transcreation Skills: Strong copywriting and transcreation skills — you can adapt marketing copy while keeping the brand's voice, tone, and intent intact.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Familiarity with CAT tools and AI-assisted translation workflows.
  • Background or strong interest in AI, imaging, or photo editing apps.

title: Técnico de Telecomunicações - Campo
description:

A Telespazio, joint venture entre Leonardo (67%) e Thales (33%), é uma líder global no setor de soluções e serviços satelitais. title: Change Management Lead
description:
About the role

You are accountable for the partner's transformation succeeding: the right problems chosen, the sponsor active, the change adopted. You operate at C-level and at depot level in the same week. Where a technical decision does not serve adoption, you decide.

What you'll do

  • Own the partner's change outcome — not a comms plan, not a training calendar, measured adoption after go-live.
  • Diagnose resistance (money, status, workload) before prescribing training or process.
  • Coach partner executives who do not report to you; keep the sponsor active through the full cycle.
  • Decide which problems the squad works on, in conversation with the Technical Implementation & Delivery Manager and the Senior Developer.
  • Build and run the change approach using a structured methodology (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter, HCMBOOK or equivalent) through to behaviour change.
  • Mobilise BEES pillars and Solutions Engineering through the TIDM; escalate when a technical shortcut would kill adoption.
  • Travel with the squad into warehouses, call centres and depots — this role is not done from a meeting room.

What you'll need

  • Strong experience in consulting or corporate transformation, and minimum 3 years leading organisational change end-to-end, and minimum 2 years on technology-enabled or digital transformation, and exposure to consumer goods, retail or distribution.
  • Experience leading change using a structured methodology through to measured adoption, not only to go-live.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and to coach senior executives who do not report to you.
  • Track record of working inside another company's operation, at leadership level and on the floor in the same week.
  • Able to operate amid ambiguity, shifting priorities and incomplete information.
  • Strong English and Spanish (both written and spoken).
  • Bachelor's degree.

Desirable

  • Prosci Certified Practitioner, CCMP, APMG Change Management Practitioner, or HCMBOOK. Certification is preferred, not a gate.
  • Experience with route-to-market or distributor transformation.
  • A second language relevant to the pilot markets.

More about you

  • Your examples name a behaviour that changed or a result that moved — not only deliverables.
  • You do not reach for formal authority in influence stories.
  • You can describe what a failure taught you.
  • You are credible and composed in front of a partner's owner.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*

  • Private pension plan
  • Meal Allowance
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance

title: ANALISTA DE PESSOAS E ADMINISTRAÇÃO
description:
• SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.
  • SOBRE A VAGA

Cargo: Analista de Pessoas e Administração

Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR

Tipo de contratação: PJ (híbrido)

Remuneração: R$ 4.200,00

Benefícios:

  • PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual)
  • Bonificação trimestral e anual por desempenho conforme política da empresa
  • ATRIBUIÇÕES

O Analista de Pessoas e Administração é responsável pela execução, controle e melhoria contínua dos processos relacionados à gestão de pessoas, rotinas administrativas e suporte organizacional. Atua de forma operacional, analítica e estratégica, garantindo a eficiência dos processos de recrutamento e seleção, administração de pessoal, desenvolvimento de pessoas, comunicação interna e apoio às lideranças. A função está fundamentado em três pilares principais:

Pessoas: encontrar, contratar e desenvolver profissionais alinhados à cultura da empresa, garantindo que todas as rotinas de liderança, acompanhamento, feedback e desenvolvimento sejam executadas de forma consistente, registradas e mantidas ativas;

Ambiente: criar e preservar um ambiente organizado, saudável e produtivo, focando no bem-estar das pessoas para que tenham condições de entregar seu melhor desempenho;

Suporte Administrativo: assumir demandas administrativas que ainda não possuam responsável definido, garantindo sua correta execução, direcionamento ou incorporação à rotina da área quando necessário.

Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção de ponta a ponta;
  • Divulgar vagas, realizar triagem de currículos, entrevistas e acompanhamento de candidatos;
  • Organizar admissões, desligamentos, folha de pagamento, benefícios, controle de ponto, férias e demais rotinas de RH e Departamento Pessoal;
  • Garantir a organização, atualização e controle de documentos, registros e acessos internos;
  • Acompanhar avaliações de desempenho, PDIs, one-on-ones, feedbacks, engajamento e demais ciclos de liderança;
  • Garantir que as rotinas de gestão de pessoas sejam executadas dentro dos prazos e padrões definidos pela empresa;
  • Manter atualizados RCFs, registros, históricos e controles relacionados aos colaboradores;
  • Apoiar ações de comunicação interna, fortalecimento da cultura e integração entre equipes;
  • Criar materiais internos, apresentações, comunicados e demais conteúdos institucionais;
  • Organizar treinamentos, eventos corporativos e ações de engajamento;
  • Resolver e organizar demandas administrativas do dia a dia, garantindo continuidade operacional;
  • Garantir a organização e o bom funcionamento dos ambientes corporativos;
  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar processos internos sempre que necessário;
  • Atuar como ponto de apoio para lideranças e colaboradores em assuntos relacionados à gestão de pessoas e rotinas administrativas;
  • Monitorar indicadores da área e propor melhorias que contribuam para o desenvolvimento das equipes e da organização.
  • REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO

Competências obrigatórias:

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído em Recursos Humanos, Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com recrutamento e seleção de ponta a ponta;
  • Experiência com rotinas completas de Departamento Pessoal;
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel e ferramentas digitais de gestão;
  • Boa noção de design, layout e comunicação visual: capacidade de organizar informações visualmente de forma clara, agradável e profissional, tendo facilidade com ferramentas como Canva, PowerPoint ou similares para produção de materiais internos;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.

Competências desejadas:

  • Experiência com cultura organizacional, comunicação interna e ações de engajamento;
  • Experiência na organização de treinamentos e eventos corporativos.
  • EXPECTATIVAS

O que buscamos:

  • Organização e proatividade: senso de prioridade, autonomia para conduzir múltiplas atividades;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal: interesse genuíno por pessoas, comunicação clara e acolhedora, capacidade de construir ambientes saudáveis e produtivos;
  • Pensamento analítico e estruturado: atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de análise e julgamento, habilidade para compreender perfis e identificar talentos;
  • Foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Perfil organizado, com zelo por documentos, prazos, eventos, agendas e rotinas administrativas;
  • Capacidade de transformar processos e comunicações em experiências claras e organizadas;

O que oferecemos:

  • Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal;
  • Direcionamento estratégico;
  • Cobrança objetiva;
  • Liberdade com responsabilidade;
  • Sinceridade e transparência.
  • ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO
  • Triagem de currículos – Análise de perfil profissional.
  • Pré-entrevista com recrutadora – Contato inicial para esclarecimento de informações e alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Teste avaliativo – Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados.
  • Entrevista CEO – Avaliação final.
  • Feedback e contratação – Formalização da contratação.

Nossa equipe te espera!

title: Garena Trainee 2027
description:
Are you ready to turn your passion for gaming into a high-impact career? At Garena, we don't just play games; we build global communities and manage the operations of the world's most popular digital entertainment titles—including the global phenomenon Free Fire.

We are looking for fresh graduates to join our Garena Trainee 2027. From Day 1, you will be embedded into the core of our daily operations, collaborating with talented peers and regional teams across the globe. You will work to support and execute our business strategies with direct guidance and support from local leadership.

Select your track:

Track A: Game Marketing - Focus on how our games reach and resonate with millions. You will master:

  • Performance Marketing & User Acquisition (UA).
  • Branding and Community building.
  • Managing influencer tribes and massive local campaigns.

Track B: Game Operations - Focus on the "engine" that keeps our games alive and profitable. You will master:

  • Game Economy and Monetization strategies.
  • Planning and executing major in-game events.
  • Data analysis to optimize player retention and experience.

Global Sync: Beyond Borders

At Garena, "Global" isn't just a buzzword—it's your daily routine. You will be part of a truly international squad, collaborating daily with our offices in Asia and across the globe. From morning syncs to large-scale global campaign rollouts, you will use your English to navigate different cultures and contribute to a business that never sleeps. If you're looking for a role where your work has no borders, you've found it!

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Education: Higher degree (Bacharelado, Tecnólogo ou Licenciatura) completed between Dec/2023 and Dec/2026.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 8 hours a day in São Paulo/SP.

Why join the Garena Squad?

Joining Garena means entering a high-octane environment where you will deal with the scale and complexity of a global gaming leader. Here, you will be part of a team that tackles real-world business challenges and manages the lifecycle of massive titles in real-time. While you will have access to guidance from experienced professionals and opportunities for professional growth, our focus is on ownership and impact. If you are looking for a fast-paced environment where your work directly affects millions of players, this is the right place for you.

Our Perks & Rewards:

  • Competitive Salary
  • CLT Contract
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Assistance
  • Meal Allowance
  • Transport/Mobility voucher
  • Life Insurance
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Learning Budget: Subsidy for formal and continuing education to keep you leveling up (available after 12 months of service).
  • Childcare Subsidy: Monthly reimbursement for daycare or nanny expenses.
  • Extended Parental Leave: 180 days for maternity leave and 20 days for paternity leave.
  • Travel Insurance

Selection process:

  • Application via LinkedIn
  • Online Assessment: Logic & English (Always check your e-mail and spam box!)
  • HR Interview
  • Business Case
  • Case Interview with Hiring Manager
  • Final Interview with Senior Leadership

Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

title: Analista de Projetos Pl

OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO

Atuar no suporte à governança e gestão do portfólio de projetos, realizando o acompanhamento operacional dos projetos, monitoramento de indicadores, controle financeiro, gestão documental e apoio às rotinas de planejamento, contribuindo para a execução eficiente dos projetos e para a melhoria contínua dos processos para atender a nível LATAM.

  • Realizar o acompanhamento do status dos projetos, consolidando informações de prazo, escopo, riscos, pendências e entregas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho dos projetos e apoiar a atualização de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Apoiar o controle e acompanhamento financeiro dos projetos, incluindo orçamento, faturamento, receitas previstas e realizadas.
  • Executar atividades de controle relacionadas a homologações, aceite financeiro entregas e validações necessárias para liberação de faturamento.
  • Apoiar a gestão documental dos projetos, garantindo atualização e rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento, registrando decisões, riscos, ações e próximos passos.
  • Apoiar a execução das rotinas de governança e cumprimento das metodologias definidas pelo PMO.
  • Auxiliar na identificação de riscos e desvios, apoiando a definição e acompanhamento de planos de ação.
  • Contribuir na preparação de materiais para treinamentos, capacitações e disseminação das metodologias de implantação.
  • Apoiar a consolidação das lições aprendidas e oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Dar suporte aos processos de entrada de novos contratos e acompanhamento dos fluxos até a implantação.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

  • Experiência em acompanhamento de projetos, PMO, operações ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos e metodologias tradicionais ou ágeis.
  • Experiência com elaboração de relatórios, indicadores e controles operacionais.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos e colaboração.
  • Conhecimento básico de gestão financeira de projetos será considerado diferencial.

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Proatividade.
  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Disciplina na execução de processos.
  • Foco em qualidade e cumprimento de prazos.

title: Web Researcher
description:
Web Research Specialist - 8-week paid contract, remote (US)

8 weeks, full-time, remote. 40 hours/week with ~$20/hour. ~ around $6,400 for the full contract.

What you'll actually do:

Work with a frontier AI model - you'll help train it, test it, and make it smarter.

Think prompt engineering meets research: you talk to the AI, find where it gets stuck, and help fix that. No coding needed.

You're a fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of research experience - you've dug through government databases, archives, registries, court records, PDFs
  • Cite the exact page, table, or section
  • Can pick up a topic you know nothing about and get to the bottom of it
  • Write clear, native-level English
  • Don't mind heavy documentation - the evidence trail is most of the work

Backgrounds we're looking for: reference librarians and archivists, investigative journalists and fact-checkers, OSINT / due diligence / KYC researchers, patent and legal-discovery searchers, genealogists, trivia and puzzle-hunt writers.

Bonus points: experience with LLM evaluation or red-teaming, comfort with JSON.

The details:

  • Contract, pay per task - no benefits or paid leave
  • 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours overlapping Pacific time
  • 8 weeks, starting ASAP
  • Hiring process: quick intro call → short assessment (Google Form) → review.

Sounds like you? Apply - it takes two minutes.

title: Alternative Investment Analyst
description:
We are a global multi-family office, with a presence in Brazil, the United States, and Europe.

Guided by our purpose of generate value to transcend generations and perpetuate legacies, since 2003 we have been building tailored investment solutions that combine strong governance and innovation to deliver efficiency and long-term wealth sustainability.

Our diverse and highly specialized team brings together different perspectives and areas of expertise to anticipate market movements and deliver unique, relevant strategies.

All our relationships are built on trust and strengthened through our everyday actions; both with our clients and with one another. caring for the client goes beyond immediate solutions: we value the uniqueness of each family's wealth and help connect generations.

The Alternative Investment Analyst will serve as the primary point of contact between Brainvest's investments and operations teams, internal relationship managers, and external parties on all operational matters. Core responsibilities include coordinating subscription processes between internal teams and fund managers, maintaining ongoing communication with offshore alternative investment fund managers, and ensuring that pricing and cash flows of private investments are accurately reflected across internal systems.

The role also encompasses the full investment lifecycle: sourcing and executing new opportunities across private credit, real estate, private equity, venture capital, and other illiquid assets, conducting due diligence, providing support in investment structuring, preparing and presenting investment committee materials, and customizing offering and marketing materials. On an ongoing basis, the Analyst will monitor Brainvest's existing alternative investment portfolio developing and refining metrics and analytics to assess performance and identify new opportunities. Additional responsibilities include reporting, developing automation projects, and contributing to client-facing materials covering portfolio updates, performance, and changes in investment strategy.

  • Location: São Paulo, SP
  • Languages: Native or Fluency proficiency in English and Portuguese are required; Spanish will be considered a plus.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate subscription processes and operational workflows between internal teams, fund managers, and external parties;
  • Ongoing monitoring and reporting of Brainvest's alternative investment portfolio, including pricing and cash flow accuracy in internal systems;
  • Assist in sourcing, due diligence, and execution of alternative investment opportunities across private credit, infrastructure, real estate, private equity, and venture capital;
  • Contribute to investment committee materials, offering documents, and client-facing materials covering portfolio updates and performance;
  • Develop automation projects and analytics to improve team efficiency and investment assessment.

Education: Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Required Experience:

  • 2-3 years of hands-on experience across the full investment cycle (sourcing, analysis, and operational execution);
  • Experience in automating complex tasks and workflows;
  • Prior experience with alternative investments/private markets is a plus.

Technical Skills:

  • Ability and openness to understanding the operational, accounting, and legal aspects of investments;
  • Written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese;
  • Familiarity with offshore jurisdictions a plus (Cayman, BVI, Delaware, Luxembourg).

Soft Skills:

  • Interest in finance and investments, with a solid understanding of accounting;
  • Attention to detail;
  • Ability to manage multiple deal and reporting processes concurrently;
  • Team player;
  • Ability to work independently;
  • Committed to self-improvement, natural curiosity, and willingness to learn and grow;
  • Comfort engaging directly with clients, fund managers, and internal stakeholders across teams.

Benefits:

  • Transportation Allowance based on commuting needs or a fixed BRL 200 monthly fuel allowance;
  • Colab+: ( TotalPass, Avus, and StarBem)
  • Health Insurance;

  • Life Insurance.

title: Analista Comercial e Administrativo
description:
Analista Comercial e Administrativo Júnior

Local de Trabalho: Vinhedo – SP | Presencial

Regime de Contratação: CLT | Tempo Integral

Reporte: Gerente / Supervisor(a) de Operações

Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Analista Comercial e Administrativo Júnior para apoiar as rotinas comerciais, administrativas e operacionais da empresa no Brasil.

A posição terá contato frequente com clientes, fornecedores, transportadoras, despachantes aduaneiros e com a matriz internacional, apoiando principalmente os processos de vendas, pedidos, faturamento, compras internacionais, importação, logística e comunicação em inglês.

Procuramos uma pessoa organizada, responsável, comunicativa e hands-on, com interesse em desenvolver uma carreira em uma empresa internacional e em um ambiente dinâmico.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Suporte Comercial e Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e cotações com base nas tabelas de preços e políticas comerciais da empresa;
  • Cadastrar, processar e acompanhar pedidos de venda no sistema ERP/CRM;
  • Conferir informações comerciais, condições de pagamento, disponibilidade de estoque e prazos de entrega;
  • Atender clientes por e-mail, telefone e videoconferência, fornecendo informações sobre pedidos, entregas, documentos e demais solicitações;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de devoluções, reclamações e solicitações técnicas junto às áreas responsáveis;
  • Manter atualizados os registros de clientes, pedidos e oportunidades no ERP/CRM;
  • Elaborar e atualizar planilhas, controles e relatórios comerciais e operacionais.

2. Compras Internacionais, Importação e Logística

  • Emitir e acompanhar Purchase Orders (POs) junto à matriz e fornecedores internacionais, principalmente na China;
  • Monitorar cronogramas de produção, lead times, embarques e previsão de chegada dos produtos;
  • Coletar, conferir e organizar documentos relacionados aos processos de importação, tais como Commercial Invoice, Packing List, B/L, AWB e Certificado de Origem;
  • Fazer interface com o Despachante Aduaneiro (Customs Broker), agentes de carga, transportadoras e demais parceiros envolvidos no processo de importação;
  • Fornecer informações e documentos necessários para os processos de DI/Duimp e desembaraço aduaneiro, seguindo os procedimentos internos da empresa;
  • Acompanhar o andamento dos processos de importação, incluindo eventuais pendências documentais, exigências fiscais e liberações aduaneiras;
  • Apoiar a conferência de informações relacionadas a impostos, despesas de importação, fretes e demais custos logísticos;
  • Acompanhar a liberação das cargas em portos e aeroportos e coordenar a entrega até a unidade da empresa;
  • Realizar cotações de fretes nacionais e acompanhar entregas junto às transportadoras.

3. Comunicação em Inglês e Suporte à Matriz

  • Manter comunicação diária, em português e inglês, com a matriz internacional, fornecedores e parceiros;
  • Participar de reuniões virtuais e presenciais em inglês, auxiliando na comunicação e no alinhamento das informações;
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a comunicação entre colaboradores brasileiros e estrangeiros durante reuniões, visitas e atividades operacionais;
  • Redigir e traduzir e-mails, relatórios, atas de reunião, documentos e comunicações internas em Português ↔ Inglês;
  • Apoiar executivos e visitantes internacionais durante reuniões, visitas a clientes, fornecedores e demais atividades no Brasil.

4. Suporte Administrativo e Operacional

  • Apoiar as rotinas administrativas do escritório e da operação;
  • Realizar cotações e compras de materiais de escritório, copa, higiene e outros itens necessários para a operação;
  • Receber e despachar documentos, correspondências, amostras e encomendas por Correios, DHL, FedEx e outros prestadores;
  • Fazer interface com prestadores de serviços relacionados à limpeza, manutenção, TI, ar-condicionado e infraestrutura do escritório;
  • Apoiar o agendamento de viagens corporativas, reuniões e recepção de visitantes;
  • Realizar a pré-conferência de faturas de frete e outras despesas operacionais;
  • Atuar como suporte aos demais membros da equipe durante férias, ausências ou períodos de maior demanda;
  • Executar outras atividades administrativas e operacionais relacionadas à função, conforme necessidade da empresa.

Requisitos

1. Formação

Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em:

  • Administração;
  • Comércio Exterior;
  • Relações Internacionais;
  • Logística;
  • Letras / Tradução;
  • ou áreas correlatas.

2. Experiência

  • Desejável experiência de 6 meses a 3 anos em atividades relacionadas a suporte comercial, administração, atendimento ao cliente, processamento de pedidos, compras, logística, importação ou comércio exterior;
  • Também serão considerados candidatos em início de carreira que apresentem bom potencial de desenvolvimento e conhecimentos compatíveis com a posição.

3. Idiomas

  • Português: fluente ou nativo;
  • Inglês: intermediário a avançado – obrigatório, especialmente para comunicação por e-mail, reuniões e contato com a matriz internacional.

4. Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Pacote Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel, em nível intermediário;
  • Conhecimento de fórmulas, PROCX/PROCV, filtros e Tabelas Dinâmicas será valorizado;
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP/CRM, como SAP, Microsoft Dynamics ou similares, será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de comércio exterior e importação, como Incoterms, NCM, DI/Duimp, documentação de importação, agentes de carga e procedimentos aduaneiros, serão considerados diferenciais.

Perfil Desejado

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Senso de responsabilidade e disciplina operacional;
  • Boa gestão de prioridades e prazos;
  • Comunicação clara e profissional;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com diferentes áreas, culturas e países;
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender;
  • Capacidade de acompanhar diversos processos simultaneamente;
  • Espírito de equipe e perfil hands-on.

Benefícios e Condições

title: Sales Ninja Wanted: Turn Refund Requests Into Retained Revenue
description:
Do Not Apply If You Do Not Speak Professional Level of English

We are a fast-growing travel facilitation company processing thousands of applications per month across multiple destinations including the United Kingdom, Thailand and Aruba. We are looking for a sharp, persuasive Customer Support Specialist to join our team and take ownership of refund disputes, chargeback defence and escalated customer communications. This is a role for someone who knows how to read people, handle objections, and turn a customer who wants their money back into one who feels understood and stays with us.

What you will be doing

  • Handling inbound refund and cancellation requests across email, and looking for the angle that resolves them in the company's favour without leaving the customer feeling unheard
  • Drafting professional, firm and legally informed responses to customer disputes
  • Managing chargeback defence submissions with supporting evidence packages
  • Liaising with payment processors on disputed transactions
  • Maintaining accurate case notes and escalating where necessary
  • Working closely with our Senior Paralegal team on complex cases

What we are looking for

  • Background in appointment setting, sales, or a closing-focused role, you know how to handle objections and guide a conversation to an outcome
  • A genuine interest in human psychology and what actually moves someone from "no" to "yes"
  • Excellent written English with strong attention to tone and detail
  • Comfortable negotiating outcomes rather than just reciting policy
  • Ability to stay calm, professional and firm under pressure
  • Familiarity with consumer protection frameworks is a strong advantage
  • Experience working with payment processors such as Stripe, Wise or similar
  • Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of cases
  • Previous experience in travel, legal support, e-commerce, or high-ticket sales is preferred
  • Love for performance

What we offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Fast-paced and dynamic environment with real ownership of your role
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership

If you know how to read a room, handle an objection, and turn a tense conversation into a win for both sides, we want to hear from you.

Apply by sending your CV and a short cover letter explaining a time you talked someone into, or out of, something. Put "pink flamingo" in the subject so I know you read this far.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Pouso Alegre, MG - Brazil

This opportunity is also open to People with Disabilities (PwD).

At Midea, we believe that innovation, operational excellence, and continuous development go hand in hand with caring for people. As a global leader in technology and home appliance solutions, we foster a collaborative environment focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

We are looking for a Graphic Designer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and management of product graphic materials and documentation for both domestic and export markets.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Graphic Designer to join our R&D team, focused on Washing Machine and Floor Care products design and communication. This role will be responsible to create the design of our products cooperating with Marketing, commercial and overseas Chinese team and matching the design and communication material according to customers and market request. Will support them in the administrative process regarding product documentation for domestic even export markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for Washing Machine graphic design development: packaging, boxes, plastic films, labels, user manuals, and promotional materials (POP)
  • Review and maintain product documents and information updated and in compliance with customers and market, even domestic or export products.

  • Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Production departments to ensure consistency across manufacturing processes, product information, packaging content, domestic or export documentation.
  • Maintain databases for product images, design files, and export documentation, ensuring version control and updates.
  • Assist customers in reviewing packaging designs and documentation requirements; develop design review with suppliers, and ensure production process with latest version.
  • Support team related to design and communication operations to domestic or export market.

Requirements:

  • Technical degree or bachelor's degree Graphic Design, Visual Communication or equivalent
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator (AI), Photoshop (PS), CorelDRAW or equivalent graphic design software.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Familiar with packaging design, label design, and print file preparation.
  • Familiar with export documentation processes and basic international trade knowledge.
  • Capable of independently handling design layouts and export documentation preparation.
  • Advanced English (for communication with global/MIB teams).

Differentials:

  • Experience in the home appliances, or durable goods industry.
  • Experience working across technical and operational departments.
  • Knowledge of relevant product standards and certifications.
  • Diligent, detail-oriented, and highly responsible.
  • Strong communication, coordination, and teamwork skills.
  • Able to adapt to a multi-tasking environment with strong time management skills.
  • Committed to continuous learning and able to respond quickly to business needs.
  • Spanish language
  • Chinese language

title: Gerente de comércio exterior
description:
Estamos chegando para revolucionar a indústria automotiva brasileira, trazendo veículos inovadores e de alta tecnologia, movidos por diversas fontes de energia, incluindo híbridos, elétricos e hidrogênio. Fundada em 1984, a GWM é uma das maiores montadoras do mundo, líder no segmento de SUVs médios na China há 11 anos consecutivos e a quarta maior fabricante global de picapes médias, segmento no qual domina há 24 anos no mercado chinês. Com presença em mais de 60 países, um time global de cerca de 80 mil colaboradores e 10 centros de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento ao redor do mundo, a GWM se destaca pela inovação e pelo compromisso com a mobilidade do futuro.

Nosso propósito é construir um futuro sustentável e inteligente, guiado pela nossa filosofia GIFT - Green Intelligent Future Technology (Tecnologia Inteligente e Sustentável do Futuro). Nossos valores essenciais são: inovação, transformação, colaboração, integridade e transparência, sempre combatendo a corrupção e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho ético e inspirador.

Com um investimento de mais de R$ 10 bilhões no Brasil, estamos prontos para redefinir os rumos da mobilidade no país. Se você quer fazer parte dessa jornada, venha construir o futuro da indústria automotiva com a GWM!

Hello, tomorrow!

Gerente de Comércio Exterior | Comex

Gerente de Comércio Exterior será responsável por liderar e supervisionar todas as operações de importação relacionadas a peças e componentes para manufatura automotiva, assegurando conformidade com a legislação aduaneira brasileira, eficiência nos processos de desembaraço e alinhamento contínuo com as necessidades produtivas da fábrica. A posição terá foco em operações Part-by-Part, CKD/SKD e importações pontuais de equipamentos industriais, atuando como principal interface com despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga e órgãos reguladores.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e coordenar operações de desembaraço aduaneiro de sistemas, subsistemas e componentes automotivos (produção e/ou peças de reposição);
  • Supervisionar processos de importação Part-by-Part e CKD, garantindo continuidade produtiva e compliance regulatório;
  • Administrar operações CKD, incluindo classificação fiscal, análise documental e condução dos procedimentos aduaneiros;
  • Coordenar importações ocasionais de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • Atuar como ponto focal junto a despachantes aduaneiros, agentes de carga e autoridades governamentais;
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar documentação de importação (fatura comercial, packing list, certificados, entre outros);
  • Assegurar correta classificação tarifária (NCM/HS), incluindo aplicação e gestão de Ex-Tarifário quando aplicável;
  • Monitorar processos aduaneiros, prazos de liberação e riscos operacionais, atuando preventivamente para mitigar atrasos;
  • Garantir conformidade com a legislação aduaneira brasileira e políticas internas de compliance;
  • Suportar auditorias, fiscalizações e esclarecimentos junto à Receita Federal e demais órgãos anuentes;
  • Atuar em estreita colaboração com Produção, Logística, Compras e Finanças para garantir alinhamento entre operações de importação e planejamento fabril.

Requisistos:

  • Graduação em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (mandatório);
  • Experiência prévia em indústria automotiva e em posições de liderança em Comex ou Logística;
  • Sólido conhecimento em Comércio Exterior e legislação aduaneira brasileira, incluindo classificação fiscal (NCM/HS), valoração aduaneira e regimes especiais (como Ex-Tarifário);
  • Experiência em importação de peças automotivas (CIF/FOB), com domínio dos modelos SKD, CKD e Part-by-Part, atuando junto a despachantes, agentes de carga e órgãos reguladores;
  • Vivência na gestão de operações complexas vinculadas à produção fabril, incluindo importação de equipamentos industriais, gestão de canal vermelho e otimização de custos logísticos e armazenagem;

title: Cloud FinOps Analyst
description:
Cloud FinOps Analyst (Multi-Cloud & GenAI Infrastructure)

Only CVs in English will be considered

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, highly analytical Cloud FinOps Analyst to establish deep financial visibility, control, and efficiency across our multi-cloud and modern AI infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Executive Leadership. You will bring rigorous financial discipline and data-driven insights to our infrastructure spend across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

We aren't just looking for someone who monitors high-level UI dashboards. We need an analyst who can roll up their sleeves, write complex SQL queries against raw billing data, run quantitative root-cause analyses on spend anomalies, and partner directly with engineering teams to execute technical cost-optimization strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Spend Visibility: Build executive dashboards and granularity reports across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic, tracking key metrics like amortized spend, forecast accuracy, unit costs, and token usage.
  • Structured Anomaly & Variance Root-Cause Analysis: Quantify and investigate budget variances. Methodically isolate drivers by slicing raw billing data by Cloud Provider.
  • Deep Infrastructure Optimization: Partner with DevOps and Engineering to evaluate technical efficiency—moving beyond basic off-hour schedules to rightsizing utilization metrics (vCPU/Memory), storage lifecycle tiering, Spot instances, and container cost allocation (EKS/GKE).
  • Commitment Strategy Management: Evaluate, purchase, and manage commitment-based discounts (AWS Savings Plans/Reserved Instances, GCP CUDs) to maximize discount coverage while maintaining flexibility.
  • GenAI & Token Cost Governance: Track unit economics (cost per prompt/token, custom GPU cluster utilization) and partner with AI engineers to set usage quotas, rate limits, and governance.
  • Cross-Functional Reconciliation: Bridge the gap between Finance and Engineering by reconciling accounting discrepancies (amortization, tax, out-of-cycle charges, billing cycle cutoff dates) using AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) as the single source of truth.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud FinOps, Cloud Cost Engineering, or Technical Financial Analysis in multi-cloud environments.
  • Hands-On SQL Capability: Proven ability to query billing datasets using aggregations (GROUP BY), window functions (PARTITION BY, dynamic rolling averages), and deduplication logic. (Note: Hands-on SQL is evaluated in our interview process).
  • Cloud & Pricing Mechanics: In-depth technical knowledge of AWS/GCP services and pricing trade-offs between On-Demand, Savings Plans, RIs, and CUDs.
  • Quantitative Problem-Solving: Ability to structure investigation frameworks for unexpected cost spikes rather than relying on high-level theoretical assumptions.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong communication skills to clearly articulate engineering trade-offs to Finance, and financial realities to Engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or AWS/GCP technical certifications.
  • Hands-on experience tracking spend, token metrics, and custom GPU infrastructure for GenAI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI).
  • Experience automating billing reconciliation or data pipelines using Python or advanced data modeling.

What We Value

  • Total Ownership: You don't just flag a spend increase—you quantify it, isolate the root cause, propose an engineering fix, and track the realized savings.
  • Technical Depth: You understand the difference between high-level dashboard summaries and underlying resource usage metrics.
  • Bridge Building: You foster a culture of cost accountability and education across engineering teams without hindering innovation or development velocity.

What We Look For

  • Strong sense of ownership — takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Self-motivated and proactive; able to operate independently with minimal supervision.
  • A good team player who collaborates effectively across teams, geographies, and time zones.
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable results in previous roles.

title: Advogado Tributário Sênior

Fazer parte da ArcelorMittal é integrar um ambiente em constante transformação, onde:

A segurança e o cuidado com as pessoas vêm sempre em primeiro lugar

Buscamos pessoas que queiram evoluir junto com a empresa, contribuindo de forma responsável, colaborativa e comprometida com resultados sustentáveis.

Você será responsável por:

  • Gerenciar carteira de processos e contingências tributárias, incluindo avaliação de risco, provisões, indicadores de desempenho e reporte à liderança.
  • Elaborar pareceres, opiniões legais e consultas tributárias envolvendo tributos federais, estaduais e municipais.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Direito;
  • OAB ativa;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria e contencioso tributário;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de tributos federais, estaduais e municipais;
  • Vivência em ambiente corporativo de grande porte ou escritórios.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou mestrado em direito tributário;
  • Formação em ciências contábeis e experiência em Big Four.

Benefícios:

  • Contamos com um pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Programa de Participação de Resultados/Remuneração Variável.
  • Retorno de férias.

  • Opção do plano Previdência Privada.

title: Atendimento ao cliente
description:
Especialista em Airbnb – Operações, Disputas e AirCover

Haute Vacation Homes | Trabalho remoto – Brasil

Estamos procurando um(a) profissional com experiência prática e avançada em Airbnb para fazer parte da nossa equipe e atuar diretamente na operação dos nossos imóveis de temporada nos Estados Unidos.

Esta não é uma vaga apenas para responder mensagens de hóspedes. Procuramos alguém que saiba defender os interesses do anfitrião dentro da plataforma, analisar cada situação e conduzir processos de reclamações, reembolsos e cobranças.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender e negociar diretamente com o Airbnb Support.
  • Analisar reclamações de hóspedes e determinar se existe fundamento para reembolso.
  • Contestar decisões do Airbnb quando entendermos que a decisão não está de acordo com as políticas ou com as evidências apresentadas.
  • Solicitar escalonamento para supervisores e equipes superiores quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar com AirCover e Resolution Center.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e negociar cobranças por danos causados por hóspedes.
  • Reunir e apresentar fotos, vídeos, mensagens, inspeções, recibos e demais evidências.
  • Acompanhar cada caso até sua conclusão, mantendo histórico de valores e decisões.
  • Identificar inconsistências nas decisões ou informações apresentadas pelo Airbnb.
  • Preparar respostas profissionais, firmes e fundamentadas para o Airbnb e para os hóspedes.
  • Conhecer e interpretar as políticas e regras do Airbnb.
  • Trabalhar também com Vrbo e outras plataformas de aluguel por temporada, quando necessário.
  • Apoiar a equipe na prevenção de reembolsos indevidos e na proteção da receita dos imóveis.
  • Criar procedimentos internos para documentar problemas, danos, reclamações e cobranças.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com nossa equipe de manutenção, limpeza, reservas e atendimento.

O que buscamos

É indispensável:

  • Experiência real trabalhando com Airbnb.
  • Conhecimento do Resolution Center.
  • Conhecimento de AirCover.
  • Experiência com cobrança de danos e disputas de reembolso.
  • Experiência em comunicação com Airbnb Support.
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação escrita.
  • Inglês avançado, principalmente para comunicação escrita.
  • Perfil organizado, analítico e muito atento aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de analisar uma situação antes de responder e construir uma argumentação baseada em fatos e evidências.
  • Proatividade para acompanhar um caso até o final, sem deixar processos parados.

Será um grande diferencial

  • Já ter conseguido reverter uma decisão do Airbnb.
  • Experiência administrando vários imóveis de temporada.
  • Experiência com Vrbo.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão de propriedades (PMS).
  • Experiência com cobrança de danos de hóspedes.
  • Experiência com disputas financeiras.
  • Conhecimento de políticas de cancelamento, reembolso, danos e reclamações do Airbnb.
  • Experiência trabalhando com propriedades localizadas nos Estados Unidos.

Perfil que procuramos

Queremos uma pessoa que seja investigativa, estratégica e firme, mas sempre profissional.

Alguém que, ao receber uma reclamação, não simplesmente diga "vamos dar o reembolso", mas pense:

"O que aconteceu? O que dizem as políticas? Temos evidências? O hóspede comunicou corretamente? Tivemos oportunidade de resolver? Qual é o nosso argumento? Como podemos contestar essa decisão?"

A pessoa contratada será uma referência interna da Haute para Airbnb, disputas, AirCover, cobranças e proteção do anfitrião.

Importante

Não estamos procurando uma empresa de gestão de imóveis.

Estamos procurando um profissional para fazer parte da nossa equipe, trabalhando remotamente do Brasil e tendo contato diário com nossa operação nos Estados Unidos.

Para se candidatar, envie:

  • Currículo ou apresentação profissional;
  • Experiência com Airbnb;
  • Quantos imóveis/reservas você já administrou;
  • Sua experiência com AirCover e Resolution Center;
  • Um exemplo de uma situação em que você contestou uma decisão do Airbnb ou conseguiu recuperar dinheiro para um anfitrião;
  • Nível de inglês;
  • Pretensão salarial;
  • Disponibilidade de horário.

Candidatos sem experiência prática com Airbnb e Resolution Center não serão priorizados.
